verdict.summary_en: Readable signed supply agreement with Annex A pricing for five parts. No corrections are visible, but the contract contains key commercial and quality conditions a buyer should note.
red_flags: Delivery term is DAP Hamburg (Incoterms 2020) unless the purchase order states otherwise.
Payment terms are NET30 from receipt of a correct invoice.
Supplier reserves capacity for Soony's rolling 12-month forecast ±20 %.
Rush orders allow up to 50,000 printed parts within 36 hours at a surcharge of 35 % on the Annex A price; rush orders are delivered by express truck DAP Hamburg.
PPAP level 3 is required for new part numbers.
Changes to process, site or sub-supplier require Soony's written approval (PCN, 90 days).
Parts printed to a superseded artwork after release are not accepted.
Late delivery penalty is 0.5 % of the delayed order value per commenced week, capped at 5 %.
Supplier maintains product liability insurance of at least EUR 5 million per event.
Agreement term is 2021-01-01 to 2027-12-31; either party may terminate for convenience with six months' notice.
